summary_en: This phase 2 trial tests alternate doses and dosing schedules of belantamab mafodotin in adults with recurrent or refractory, triple-class refractory multiple myeloma. The drug is given intravenously (IV) on day 1 of each cycle, and cycles repeat every 6 weeks if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable; one arm repeats the next cycle at 3 weeks before moving to every 6 weeks. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; this is a phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa dosis y esquemas de administración alternativos de belantamab mafodotina en adultos con mieloma múltiple recurrente o refractario, refractario a tres clases de tratamiento. El medicamento se administra por vena (IV) el día 1 de cada ciclo, y los ciclos se repiten cada 6 semanas si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables; en un brazo, el siguiente ciclo se repite a las 3 semanas y luego cada 6 semanas. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; es un ensayo de fase 2.
who_for: Multiple myeloma that progressed after at least 3 prior lines, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory agent, and an anti-CD38 antibody.
Measurable disease by serum or urine M-protein, or by free light chain levels.
Blood counts, liver tests and kidney function within the required limits, checked within 28 days before registration.
not_for: Active plasma cell leukemia, symptomatic amyloidosis, active POEMS syndrome, or Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia.
Unresolved toxicity grade 2 or higher from previous treatment, except alopecia or neuropathy up to grade 2.
Other cancer, unless considered medically stable for more than 2 years or curatively treated nonmelanoma skin cancer.
Current corneal epithelial disease, except mild punctuate keratopathy.
